subject.title: fix(anthropic): read claudeCodeVersion at runtime to prevent stale user-agent bearer auth failures

question: What is the supported source and failure policy for the Claude compatibility version used by embedded Anthropic setup-token requests when no Node-resolvable Claude Code package exists?
rationale: The choice determines whether valid native Claude installations fail closed, whether OpenClaw owns a compatibility value, and whether the preferred claude-cli runtime or the embedded provider should supply the identity fact; repository behavior and upstream installation methods do not make that policy automatic.

options.title: Prepared multi-install resolver
options.body: Resolve and validate the version once from the supported CLI/install metadata, including native installations, then inject the prepared value into both OAuth builders.

options.title: Require npm package
options.body: Explicitly support only Node-resolvable @anthropic-ai/claude-code for the embedded setup-token path, document the operator requirement, and add startup diagnostics plus upgrade proof.

options.title: Retire embedded impersonation path
options.body: Route subscription authentication exclusively through the actual Claude CLI runtime and separately migrate or deprecate embedded setup-token behavior.

recommendation.title: Prepared multi-install resolver
recommendation.body: Resolve and validate the version once from the supported CLI/install metadata, including native installations, then inject the prepared value into both OAuth builders.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on Claude CLI authentication routing makes this the strongest available owner signal for deciding the runtime boundary.
